item.name: CREDENTIA CONTENT HUB
item.label: Internal tool
item.description: Built for the Credentia team in Nigeria, the hub takes content from topic discovery through source-backed research to drafting and export. Writers attach citations, work in a Markdown editor, and use editorial approval gates before exporting Markdown, JSON or PDF packages. It works with the AI provider of your choice, with a monthly spend limit, and runs locally or hosted for the whole team.
